understanding: Individual code review catches unit bugs in isolated functions; system-level review catches integration gaps and architectural breakdown across call chains that AI cannot evaluate.

1_business_logic_correctness.definition: AI faithfully implements whatever specification was prompted; it cannot assess whether the prompt aligns with actual product business requirements.
1_business_logic_correctness.analogy: Like a builder pouring concrete exactly where the blueprint marks, even if the blueprint accidentally placed the front door over an open swimming pool.
1_business_logic_correctness.taskflow_audit_target: Verification of RBAC invitation rules (only team owner/admin can invite, not general members).

2_security_in_context.definition: Functions that are clean, sanitized, and secure in isolation become catastrophic vulnerabilities when called in an unauthenticated or unauthorized multi-hop call chain.
2_security_in_context.analogy: Like a high-security bank vault door installed on a shed made of cardboard walls.
2_security_in_context.taskflow_audit_target: Verifying team ownership/membership on every nested route (/teams/:teamId/invitations, /tasks/:id/comments) rather than trusting inner helpers.

3_architectural_coherence.definition: Disjointed agents introduce divergent paradigms (custom error formats vs standard middleware, raw queries vs repository pattern, disparate REST vs RPC naming).
3_architectural_coherence.analogy: Like assembling a car where four different teams built doors that each use completely different handles, hinges, and key locks.
3_architectural_coherence.taskflow_audit_target: Enforcing uniform AppError conventions, standardized HTTP response envelopes, and centralized logging across services.

4_data_integrity_under_pressure.definition: AI writes happy-path code assuming single-threaded execution; race conditions, concurrent acceptance, and cascading deletes cause corrupt state.
4_data_integrity_under_pressure.analogy: Like a single-seat revolving door that shatters when five people try to squeeze through at the exact same second.
4_data_integrity_under_pressure.taskflow_audit_target: Handling concurrent invitation acceptance and orphan comment prevention on team/task deletion.

5_compliance_and_privacy.definition: AI produces generic boilerplate audit trails that may fail statutory compliance (GDPR/SOC2) or unlawfully log sensitive credentials and PII.
5_compliance_and_privacy.analogy: Like a security logbook that dutifully writes down everyone's entry time, but also copies down their credit card numbers and passport pins in plain view.
5_compliance_and_privacy.taskflow_audit_target: Sanitizing audit logs and activity payloads to strip auth tokens, hashes, and sensitive personal identifiers.
